hook: Alone, hurt and out of water, high in the mountains.
narration: She was alone, hurt, and out of water, high in the mountains of southern Arizona.
The hiker had fallen in the Huachuca Mountains, and she set off her emergency locator beacon.
A Black Hawk crew from Customs and Border Protection's Air and Marine Operations launched to find her.
Strong winds and steep terrain made it hard to find anywhere safe to put people down.
A beacon sends a distress signal by satellite, so the crew knew roughly where to search before they could see her.
They lowered two rescue specialists down the hoist cable, into the trees.
The specialists checked her, then moved her to a spot where the helicopter could lift her out safely.
They strapped her into a rescue vest and clipped her to the cable. [short pause] Then the Black Hawk pulled them up.
outcome: She was hoisted into the helicopter and flown to Cochise County Search and Rescue, a few miles away.
title: Hurt and alone high in the mountains
description:
On March 16, 2022, a CBP Air and Marine Operations Black Hawk crew lowered two rescue specialists to an injured hiker who was alone and out of water in the Huachuca Mountains of Arizona, then hoisted her out.
